name: Arcane Domain
description: The pure energy coursing through this area leaves battles yielding unexpected effects.
effect:
- Dragon-Type attacks gain 2 Chance Dice to apply either Burn, Frostbite or Paralysis on their first hit, Which status is applied is random amongst those three. Dragon-Type pokemon may choose instead. In the case of an All Foes moves, Only roll Chance Dice against the primary target.
- Dragon-Type Pokemon gain STAB on Fire, Ice or Electric type moves, chosen at the start of their turn.
- Electric, Fire, and Ice-Type Pokemon gain STAB on Dragon-Type Moves.
- Fairy Types are now only Resistant to Dragon Type attacks rather than Immune.
